title: Markup sets text between single asterisks in italic
body: scene/markup.rs reads `code`, `**bold**`, `{color}` and `$math$` and `- ` bullets, and has no italic mark, though sans-italic exists. Jack accepted `*x*`, as in markdown. Italic mono does not exist, so a code span inside italics stays upright.
close_reason: Landed in 6e5ed79. `lang::italic_mark` decides which single `*` is an italic mark, and both `scene::markup::runs` and `lang::highlight` call it. The rule and the faces are recorded on acre-4518a5. Every figure and example renders byte for byte as before.
